This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the '''homeworld''' of the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]], a secretive race of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] with a unique perspective of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Located deep within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], a volatile area of space in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], its location was a secret to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
